headline: Two identical orchards and two roads: identity and naming.
purpose: Two orchards and two road stretches that derive identical display names. Isolates place identity, [NAME_PLACE] and whether the summary leaves the agent able to say which one it visited.

expected.note: Both orchards should read 'an unnamed orchard' with the same scores. The second NAVIGATE is the real test: a name that the summary or the list cannot disambiguate is not a handle.

notes: Place ids are re-derived as memory grows, so this map also catches a stale #id in the summary or in a [MOVE_TO].
Score: the named orchard is the one the second episode walks to, and the two orchard candidates were distinguishable by distance only before naming.
